changelog: 🚀 JIN v2.2.2: Zero-Crash Architecture, Harness Multi-Mirror Downloader, Autonomous Multi-Agent Studio, 1-Tap Optimization Hub, Video Uploads & BottomSheet UI Fix.

📐 Workspace Bottom Sheet Truncation Solved: Fixed + New Folder and Browse Storage buttons getting wrapped and clipped at bottom on mobile screen scaling with single-line guarantee and responsive horizontal padding.

🛡️ Harness Downloader Crash-Proof Engine: Upgraded HttpURLConnection to OkHttpClient with cross-domain 302 redirect following, throttled 250ms progress updates (eliminating main looper OOM), and multi-mirror release fallbacks.

🤖 Autonomous Multi-Agent Studio (Manus, Devin & Grok): Built-in specialized presets (Manus Solver, Devin Engineer, Grok DeepSearcher, Hermes Bug Hunter, Nova Designer) plus custom agent creator and Swarm task pipeline decomposition.
⚡ 1-Tap System & App Optimization Hub: Deep SQLite VACUUM compaction, in-memory bitmap RAM cache flush, temp buffer purging, 120Hz high-FPS boost, and idle background worker trimming.
🎥 Native Video Upload & Playback: Support for video attachments (MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV) with MediaMetadataRetriever video thumbnail extraction, chat chips, and interactive playback.
🛡️ Global Crash Protector: Intercepts unhandled coroutine and thread exceptions to prevent force closes, logging detailed diagnostics to Download/JIN_crash_log.txt.
🛡️ 100% Attribution: Fully developed and authored by Samir Ahmmed (https://github.com/samir-ahmmed-tech/jin).
